$comment: Issue-routing registry for zheref/Ztyle (this product repository) and the tool repositories it consumes. Authored at Hatsu adoption on 2026-10-22 from the owner's answers: kind product, role consumer, gate G2 (the maintainer's ruling of 2026-09-18 that the gate is the repository's role, not the file's kind). No remote existed at adoption; at bootstrap on 2026-10-23 the slug was set to GitHub's canonical case, zheref/Ztyle (public). `product_codes` carries no nested `$comment`: nen's repos loader reads every key of that map as a code.

consumers.role: Ztyle, a Gatsby wardrobe planner -- the product this registry belongs to
